lead.question: 新闻报道真能改变人的命运吗？五胞胎一家的遭遇说明了什么？
lead.warmup: 在民主国家，限制新闻自由会遭到谴责，但新闻自由一旦被滥用，也可能让普通人付出沉重代价。记者以“事实至上”为名发表他人的私人生活细节，往往给当事人带来难以言说的痛苦。报刊威力巨大，既能改变寻常人家的命运，甚至能推翻政府。本课讲述美国南达科他州一户穷人家喜得五胞胎，一夜成名暴富，却从此失去正常生活。这样的“好运”究竟是福还是祸？
goals: 掌握 press / journalist / editor / publicity / influence 等新闻类核心词汇及搭配。
理解并运用被动语态（are condemned / be replaced / has been interviewed）在课文中的表达。
学习 such...that、not only...but also、that 引导的定语从句及现在分词短语等结构。
体会作者对新闻自由与商业化双重性的批判态度，培养思辨与表达能力。
lead.summary: 课文先立论：新闻自由不容限制，却极易被滥用，记者以事实为名披露隐私，给人带来痛苦；报刊威力巨大，甚至能推翻政府。接着以南达科他州一户穷人家为例：他们已有五个孩子，又意外生下五胞胎，一夜成名。但记者围追采访，父母不得不请律师应对，最终沦为商业化的受害者，孩子也成了商品。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：newspapers 作主语指报刊时本课按复数处理，故用 they、exert、can；表示“记者”用 reporter/journalist，“编辑”用 editor，不可与 press（新闻界、报刊）混用。

questions.q: Does the writer think the parents where lucky or unlucky to gain prosperity in this way? Why?
questions.zh: 作者认为这户人家以这种方式获得富足是幸运还是不幸？为什么？
questions.a: The writer thinks they were unlucky. Although they gained fame and prosperity, they paid the price for it: they could never lead normal lives again, and became the victims of commercialization.
questions.aZh: 作者认为他们是不幸的。虽然他们名利双收，却为此付出了代价：再也无法过正常生活，成了商业化的受害者。
questions.hint: 答案见课文最后三句，关键词 paying the price for fame 与 the victims of commercialization。

questions.q: Where did the family live, and why was life a perpetual struggle against poverty?
questions.zh: 这户人家住在哪里？为什么他们常年在贫困中挣扎？
questions.a: They lived in Aberdeen, a small town of 23,000 inhabitants in South Dakota. As they already had five children and were expecting a sixth, they faced even more pressing economic problems.
questions.aZh: 他们住在南达科他州一个拥有23,000人口的小镇 Aberdeen。因为已有五个孩子、第六个即将出生，他们面临更严峻的经济问题。
questions.hint: 见课文 The family lived in Aberdeen... 与 As the parents had five children...

questions.q: What did newspapers and magazines offer the family, and what gifts poured in?
questions.zh: 报纸和杂志向这家人提出了什么？涌来的又是哪些礼物？
questions.a: They offered the family huge sums for the exclusive rights to publish stories and photographs. Gifts poured in not only from unknown people but also from baby food and soap manufacturers who wished to advertise their products.
questions.aZh: 他们出高价购买文字和图片的独家报道权。礼物不仅来自素昧平生的人，也来自想为产品做广告的婴儿食品和肥皂厂商。
questions.hint: 见 Newspapers and magazines offered the family huge sums... 与 Gifts poured in not only...

questions.q: Why did the family have to employ lawyers, and what does this show about fame?
questions.zh: 这家人为什么不得不聘请律师？这说明成名带来了什么？
questions.a: Because reporters kept pressing for interviews, so lawyers had to act as spokesmen for the family at press conferences. It shows that fame brought them heavy pressure and cost them a normal life.
questions.aZh: 因为记者不断要求采访，律师不得不充当他们家的发言人举行记者招待会。这说明名声给他们带来巨大压力，让他们失去了正常生活。
questions.hint: 见 Reporters kept pressing for interviews so lawyers had to be employed...

questions.q: In the last sentence, why does the writer say the children had become a commodity rather than five new family members? What is he criticizing?
questions.zh: 课文末句说孩子们“成了商品”而非五个新的家庭成员，作者借此批判什么？
questions.a: Because their names had acquired a market value and were bought and sold as news, the children were turned into objects of commercial profit. The writer criticizes commercialization and the abuse of press freedom.
questions.aZh: 因为他们的名字有了市场价值，被当作新闻买卖，孩子沦为商业盈利的对象。作者借此批判商业化以及新闻自由的滥用。
questions.hint: 见课文最后两句 the victims of commercialization 与 a commodity。

exercises.q: 汉译英：在民主国家，任何限制新闻自由的企图都理所当然地受到谴责。
exercises.a: In democratic countries any efforts to restrict the freedom of the press are rightly condemned.

exercises.q: 汉译英：新闻具有如此巨大的影响力，以至于它们甚至能推翻一个政府。
exercises.a: Newspapers exert such tremendous influence that they can even overthrow a government.

exercises.q: 改为被动语态：Reporters have interviewed the family many times.
exercises.a: The family has been interviewed by reporters many times.
exercises.note: 现在完成时被动 has been done。

exercises.q: 填空（每空一词）：The ______ decides what goes into a newspaper; after the story broke, the family gained instant ______.
改错：Every journalists wanted to interview the famous family.
exercises.a: Every journalist wanted to interview the famous family.

exercises.q: 合并为含定语从句的一句：A poor family acquired fame and fortune overnight. The story of the family dramatically illustrates the power of the press.
exercises.a: The story of a poor family that acquired fame and fortune overnight dramatically illustrates the power of the press.
exercises.note: that 引导定语从句修饰 family。

exercises.q: 用强调句型 It was...that 强调地点状语：The family lived in Aberdeen.
exercises.a: It was in Aberdeen that the family lived.

quiz.q: 课文说，在民主国家，任何限制新闻自由的企图会怎样？
quiz.note: are rightly condemned 理所当然受谴责。

quiz.q: 课文用哪个短语说明报刊的威力能“推翻一个政府”？
quiz.note: overthrow a government 推翻政府。

quiz.q: 这户人家生下的五胞胎是？
报纸和杂志出高价向这家人购买什么？
options: the exclusive rights to publish stories and photographs

quiz.q: 课文结尾说这些孩子立即变成了什么？
quiz.note: a commodity 商品，而非家庭成员。
